Overview: Multilinguard builds cloud-native contact center orchestration for enterprise telcos and retail chains. Current roadmap: ship agent-assist + automated ticket summarization + real-time in-call translation for 2025 Q2. They want a unified inference layer to avoid building per-region stacks.

Discovery notes (bulleted):
- 2024-09-12: Intro call (Jordan P.) — interested in replacing brittle microservices translation pipeline. Wants single API for: translate+tone, tool-calling (CRM update + ticket create), and agent prompt assist.
- 2024-10-02: Architecture deep-dive w/ SE (Priya D.) — strict requirement: EU customer transcripts must never leave EU control plane. Also want audit logs + KMS integration.
- 2024-10-28: Product demo (recording ff-20241028-1147) — showed sample workflow: live transcription -> locale-aware paraphrase -> suggested actions (update ticket, escalate). Customer asked: "Can you keep Spanish replies formal for banking clients and casual for retail?"
- 2024-11-05: Security quick sync (ff-20241105-0913) — asked for SOC2 attestation, encryption-at-rest proof, and SSO/SAML SAML metadata exchange. Provided security FAQ in Drive.
- 2024-11-12: Internal procurement call — finance flagged ARR range, asked for committed throughput tiers and burst pricing.

POC scope:
- Deliver 10k real-world tickets (anonymized) across En/Es/Fr/Ja/pt-BR for summarization quality baseline.
- Real-time agent assist tests with latency target: p50 < 120ms; p95 < 300ms for English; allow +100ms slack for double-hop translation (e.g., EN->JA->EN).  Target throughput during POC: 500 rps sustained with 2k rps burst for short windows.
- Tool-calling: prototype connectors to Zendesk + internal CRM; verify API auth flows and idempotency.
- Regional routing: prove automated fallback using lower-cost model in non-critical regions without visible degradation to agents.

Model & quality preferences:
- Prefer open quantized models if unit cost delta > 3x vs hosted proprietary. Will accept Redwood-managed variants if latency and safety are guaranteed.
- Quality evaluation: BLEU/ChrF not enough — want human-labeled pairwise evals for tone preservation. We discussed Redwood Optimize ideas for regression alerts tied to sample prompt sets.

Commercial & ops:
- Interested in Dedicated for predictable latency, leaning Private (VPC) for EU teleco customers. Hosted API could be used for early-stage markets (APAC) if data residency can be isolated.
- Procurement timeline: internal legal + data residency approval expected by end of Dec; vendor eval and SLA negotiation through Jan. Forecast close 2025-01.

Quotes / friction:
- From Head of Product: "We need translations that keep the brand voice — not just literal text."
- From Security lead: "If audit trails aren't per-tenant we can't proceed."

Action items (recent):
- 11/18: Sent POC onboarding checklist and anonymized sample mapping (attached Drive link).
- 11/20: SE to start synthetic load test plan; confirm required GPU instance types and quantization profiles.
- Next: schedule SSO metadata exchange and legal redline on data residency appendix.

Potential upsell / long-term value:
- Full routing + autoscaling combo (Dedicated + Optimize) for high season spikes (holiday retail).
- Custom tone models for marquee banking clients (professional services add-on).

CRM tone: shorthand, action-oriented. Customer engaged but risk around legal/residency windows and SSO timing.
